programme.title: Leo, el explorador

programme.desc: Cuando los padres neoyorquinos Chris y Heather visitaron por primera vez la aldea de montaña de Midway, Utah, se enamoraron del encanto de la ciudad, las vistas panorámicas y el acceso a divertidas actividades al aire libre.

programme.title: Buying Alaska
programme.desc: Mientras el invierno llega a Alaska, Jason y Alana Harris quieren un hogar donde puedan salir y disfrutar de las desafiantes pistas de nieve a través de las montañas.

programme.title: Buying Alaska
programme.desc: Steve y Peg Kreun quieren vivir en un lago de Alaska en el Valle Mat-Su, para disfrutar del aire libre y la pesca.

programme.title: Pantano: Se Vende
programme.desc: Pareja que perdió su hogar durante el huracán Katrina busca un hogar que pueda resistir huracanes.

programme.title: Pantano: Se Vende
programme.desc: Una pareja está en busca de una casa para pasar los fines de semana, pero no puede decidir si comprar el pantano o la playa.

programme.title: Los caza minihogares
programme.desc: Una mujer, superviviente de un cáncer, y su esposo quieren una pequeña casa en Winston-Salem, Carolina del Norte.

programme.title: Los caza minihogares
programme.desc: Padres quieren hallar una casa móvil con campo para su familia grande, para poder viajar por el país.

programme.title: Los caza hogares
programme.sub-title: El costo del personaje en West Virginia
programme.desc: Una pareja busca una casa que desprenda carácter en Morgantown, Virginia Occidental. Para él, eso equivale a una vivienda antigua en el distrito histórico de la ciudad, pero ella busca algo más nuevo y rústico.

programme.title: Los caza hogares
programme.desc: Una mujer soltera de 27 años busca comprar su primera casa fuera de Atlanta. Su madre y la agente inmobiliaria, que es amiga de la madre, le ayudan con la búsqueda, pero sus recomendaciones no concuerdan con lo que ella quiere.

programme.title: Una casa fabulosa
programme.desc: Chelsea y Cole toman la casa de campo de una pareja y buscan transformarla en una declaración audaz que celebra los elementos rústicos y un concepto abierto glamoroso.

programme.title: Chopped: Eliminado
programme.desc: La cesta de aperitivos contiene un ingrediente "embriagador"; en la ronda de entrada un chef juega con fuego; los ingredientes finales son arroz amarillo y caqui.

programme.title: Rodando por América
programme.desc: En Boston, pollo y gofres y tots; en Jackson, Wyoming, ramen de cerdo; en Superior, Wisconsin, una pizza con carne curada en casa.

programme.title: Rodando por América

programme.title: Back to the Secret Garden
programme.desc: An American orphan living in England as part of an exchange program researches information about a special garden.

programme.title: Sea Level
programme.desc: When poachers steal dozens of egg sacks from his reef, bamboo shark Pup makes it his personal mission to save his unhatched brothers and sisters. His rescue mission takes him above water into the world of man.

programme.title: Sea Level 2: Magic Arch
programme.desc: A young dolphin with an active imagination discovers a magic arch that makes wishes come true. However, when its enemies use the arch to become big and strong, it must find a way to stop them.

programme.title: Sea Level 3: Dolphin Boy
programme.desc: A little boy survives a plane crash and is rescued by a young wild dolphin. They grow up together, entertaining marine life with their funny tricks. One day, the peace of their joyful world is destroyed by an evil octopus.

programme.title: Morning Glory
programme.desc: Disaster follows a producer's (Rachel McAdams) decision to bring in a legendary TV anchor (Harrison Ford) to revitalize a struggling morning-news program.

programme.title: Norm of the North: King Sized Adventure
programme.desc: An ancient Chinese artifact has been stolen by a villainous archaeologist named Dexter. With the help of his lemming friends, Norm must keep his word and embark on a journey across the world to help recover the artifact for the people of China.

programme.title: Norm of the North: Family Vacation
programme.desc: Norm searches for his missing crown while fixing his family relationships.

programme.title: Fred 2: Night of the Living Fred
programme.desc: A teenager (Lucas Cruikshank) tries to convince everyone that his new neighbor (Seth Morris) is a vampire.

programme.title: A Mermaid's Tale
programme.desc: Twelve-year-old Ryan is despondent about moving to a dying seacoast village until she forms an unlikely friendship with a quirky teenage mermaid.

programme.title: Pit Pony
programme.desc: When Ned is temporally laid off as the mine puts in new electric wires, Nellie thinks about getting a job; but Ned, due to his pride and ego, strongly opposes her choice to look for work; meanwhile, Miss Harper sets up a reading class at the mine.

programme.title: Paws P.I.
programme.desc: A boy recruits his talking dog and parrot to help him take down a tyrannical tycoon who's determined to stop a local mansion from being turned into an animal rescue.

programme.title: Jurassic Park
programme.desc: An entrepreneur invites scientists (Sam Neill, Laura Dern), a mathematics theorist (Jeff Goldblum) and others to his jungle theme-park featuring dinosaurs regenerated from DNA.

programme.title: The Lost World: Jurassic Park
programme.desc: Four years after "Jurassic Park," mathematician Ian Malcolm ventures onto a second island to save his girlfriend from becoming dinosaur bait.

programme.title: Jurassic Park III
programme.desc: Dinosaur expert Dr. Alan Grant and a search party become trapped on an island of prehistoric predators. Can they escape alive with Dr. Alan Grant leading the party?

programme.title: Leo the Lion
programme.desc: A young vegetarian lion is shunned by other carnivores.

programme.title: Jungle Master
programme.desc: Transported to a magical land, a girl (Victoria Justice) meets an emerging leader (Josh Peck) who must save the rain forest from an evil scientist.

programme.title: Girl in Progress
programme.desc: With her mom (Eva Mendes) seemingly too busy to pay attention to her, a teen (Cierra Ramirez) hatches a misguided plan to skip adolescence and jump right into adulthood.

programme.title: Jurassic Tale
programme.desc: After a baby T. rex hatches from a prehistoric egg found in a nearby cave, siblings Emma and Brian must outsmart an evil scientist who wants the dinosaur for his own nefarious purposes.

programme.title: Jurassic Park
programme.desc: An entrepreneur invites scientists (Sam Neill, Laura Dern), a mathematics theorist (Jeff Goldblum) and others to his jungle theme-park featuring dinosaurs regenerated from DNA.

programme.title: The Lost World: Jurassic Park
programme.desc: Four years after "Jurassic Park," mathematician Ian Malcolm ventures onto a second island to save his girlfriend from becoming dinosaur bait.

programme.title: Jurassic Park III
programme.desc: Dinosaur expert Dr. Alan Grant and a search party become trapped on an island of prehistoric predators. Can they escape alive with Dr. Alan Grant leading the party?

programme.title: The Legend of Catclaws Mountain
programme.desc: Mindy adopts Angel, a pony that according to legend will lead its owner to gold. When Angel is kidnapped, Mindy and her friends head into the hills to rescue the pony and hunt for the lost gold.

programme.title: The Equalizer 2
programme.desc: Robert McCall's mysterious past cuts especially close to home when thugs kill Susan Plummer, his best friend and former colleague. Now out for revenge, McCall must take on a crew of highly trained assassins who'll stop at nothing to destroy him.

programme.title: Gangs of New York
programme.desc: During the era of Tammany Hall's sway, a young man (Leonardo DiCaprio) vows vengeance on the vicious gangster (Daniel Day-Lewis) who killed his father.

programme.title: Sleeping Dogs
programme.desc: Suffering from memory loss, a former homicide detective tries to solve a brutal murder that he can't recall. As he pieces together evidence from a decade-old investigation, he soon uncovers a sinister web of buried secrets tied to his forgotten past.

programme.title: A Simple Plan
programme.desc: A Minnesotan (Bill Paxton), his dimwitted brother (Billy Bob Thornton) and his brother's redneck friend (Brent Briscoe) find and decide to keep $4 million.

programme.title: The Score
programme.desc: A master thief (Robert De Niro) agrees to work with a volatile partner (Edward Norton) for one last heist before he retires.

programme.title: The Saint
programme.desc: A clever thief who is known as the master of creating false identities using the names of Catholic saints, is hired by the Russian Mafia for his next mission. But things get complicated when he falls for Emma Russel, the scientist.

programme.title: When Harry Met Sally...
programme.desc: Harry and Sally have known each other for years, and are very good friends, but they fear sex would ruin the friendship.

programme.title: You've Got Mail
programme.desc: Boutique bookseller Kathleen hates Joe, the owner of a corporate Foxbooks chain store that just moved in across the street. When they meet online, however, they begin an intense and anonymous Internet romance, oblivious of each other's true identity.

programme.title: Forrest Gump
programme.desc: JFK, LBJ, Vietnam, Watergate and other history unfold through the perspective of an Alabama man (Tom Hanks) with an IQ of 75.

programme.title: Apocalypse Now Redux
programme.desc: An Army agent (Martin Sheen) goes upriver into the heart of Cambodia to kill a renegade colonel (Marlon Brando).

programme.title: Total Recall
programme.desc: Recurring nightmares of the planet Mars lead a confused earthling into the center of an intergalactic conspiracy.

programme.title: Terminator 2: Judgment Day
programme.desc: Two cyborgs from the future battle over the life of a teen (Edward Furlong) who will someday lead humanity against the machines.

programme.title: Molly's Game
programme.desc: Molly Bloom runs the world's most exclusive high-stakes poker game for a decade before being arrested by the FBI. Her only ally is defense lawyer Charlie Jaffey, who learns that there is much more to Molly than the tabloids lead people to believe.

programme.title: Hotel Transylvania
programme.desc: Dracula becomes overprotective when a human boy discovers his monsters-only resort during a birthday celebration and falls for his teenage daughter.

programme.title: Beastly
programme.desc: After a spurned classmate curses him, a teen will be forever ugly unless he finds love.

programme.title: Walking Out
programme.desc: When a city teen travels to Montana to go hunting with his estranged father, the trip becomes a battle for survival when they encounter a grizzly bear.

programme.title: Brave the Dark
programme.desc: When Mr. Deen discovers one of his students has been living out of his car and thrown into jail, he decides to bail him out. Determined to curb Nate's self-destructive behavior, Mr. Deen discovers a host of secrets that are slowly tearing Nate apart.

programme.title: Dunkirk
programme.desc: Germany advances into France, trapping Allied troops on the beaches of Dunkirk. Under air and ground cover from British and French forces, troops are slowly and methodically evacuated from the beach using every vessel that can be found.

programme.desc: Tragedy strikes a Syrian family in Aleppo, starting a chain reaction of events involving five different families in four different countries.

programme.desc: A woman's (Rooney Mara) world unravels after her psychiatrist (Jude Law) prescribes a new medication to treat her anxiety.

programme.desc: Archaeologist Jones (Harrison Ford) rescues his kidnapped father (Sean Connery), and the two race the Nazis to find the Holy Grail.

programme.desc: Edizione del notiziario televisivo a cura della redazione giornalistica di Rai 1. Ogni giorno, le informazioni più importanti a livello nazionale e internazionale: cronaca, politica, cultura, società e sport.

programme.title: Unomattina
programme.desc: Spazi dedicati all'attualità, al costume e alla cultura si alternano alla rassegna stampa e alla discussione delle principali notizie.

programme.title: Storie italiane
programme.desc: Storie straordinarie e storie di ogni giorno si alternano e intrecciano in studio per raccontare l'Italia. I protagonisti raccontano le proprie vicende in prima persona, coadiuvati da giornalisti, esperti e inviati che commentano i fatti.

programme.title: Cinque minuti
programme.desc: Una nuova striscia informativa per raccontare l'Italia e il mondo giorno per giorno. Assistiamo a interviste a personaggi della politica interna e internazionale, del mondo artistico, culturale e dello spettacolo, tra temi sociali ed economici.

programme.title: Quante storie
programme.desc: Fatti, vicende, libri, film e mostre che raccontano i cambiamenti dell'Italia contemporanea. Tra interviste, dibattiti, recensioni e stroncature, è possibile osservare uno spaccato del paese.

programme.title: TgR Buongiorno Italia
programme.desc: Programma con le informazioni più salienti di attualità a cura della redazione regionale del telegiornale di RAI3.

programme.desc: Le ultime notizie su politica, sport, cultura e società a cura della redazione del Tg2.

programme.title: Ore 14
programme.desc: La nostra società vista attraverso gli occhi di ragazzi e ragazze, chiamati a partecipare ed essere protagonisti del dibattito. Cronaca, politica, attualità, partendo dal fatto del giorno.

programme.title: Paparazzi!
programme.desc: I due presentatori ci raccontano con allegria, e in lingua inglese, i fatti principali che avvengono in Italia. Le notizie vengono presentate con un taglio accessibile anche a chi conosce meno il paese.

programme.title: Casa Italia
programme.desc: Scopriamo insieme notizie di attualità, sport, cinema, moda e musica di RAI Italia per gli italiani all'estero e per quanti nel mondo amano l'Italia e la sua grande ricchezza culturale, paesaggistica e produttiva.

programme.title: L'eredità
programme.desc: Sette concorrenti si sfidano in diverse prove a eliminazione, fino a raggiungere la fase finale del gioco, l'imperdibile Ghigliottina. Qui, per vincere, il campione deve indovinare una parola con l'aiuto di alcuni indizi.

programme.title: Tg1
programme.desc: Edizione del notiziario televisivo a cura della redazione giornalistica di Rai 1. Ogni giorno, le informazioni più importanti a livello nazionale e internazionale: cronaca, politica, cultura, società e sport.

programme.title: Gli Italians
programme.desc: Esploriamo le vite e le azioni di alcune donne e uomini appartenenti alla diaspora italiana nel mondo. Ridisegnamo una mappa dei nostri connazionali attraverso il loro racconto autobiografico.

programme.title: È sempre mezzogiorno
programme.desc: La cucina come contesto in cui parlare di attualità con i numerosi ospiti in studio, tra i quali cuochi professionisti ed esperti di alimentazione, e giocare con il pubblico a casa.

programme.title: Cartoni animati
programme.desc: Selezione di cartoni animati a cura della rete: spazio di programmazione dedicato ai più piccoli.

programme.title: Geo
programme.desc: Natura, terra, mare, vento. I passi degli uomini che attraversano questa terra, i loro cibi, la loro difficile convivenza con l'ambiente che li circonda. La natura e l'ambiente, il futuro del nostro Pianeta e le tradizioni del nostro Paese.

programme.title: Il paradiso delle signore
programme.desc: A 3 anni dalla tragica morte di Pietro Mori, Vittorio Conti investe le energie per riaprire il grande magazzino dell'amico. L'uomo si mette però in affari con la potente famiglia Guarnieri, gente senza scrupoli disposta a tutto.

programme.title: Affari tuoi
programme.desc: Il famoso gioco dei pacchi, nel quale i concorrenti provenienti ciascuno da una regione diversa sfidano il banco per vincere un montepremi fino a 300.000 euro.

programme.title: La giostra del gol
programme.desc: I momenti più significativi del campionato di Serie A: Coppa Italia, dai quarti di finale in poi, e della Supercoppa italiana.
